description: Cartes de l'assainissement non collectif (ANC) sur le bassin Loire-Bretagne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agence de l'eau Loire-Bretagne. Maps of non-collective sanitation (ANC) in the Loire-Bretagne basin in 2014. The data comes from SPANC (Public Non-Collective Sanitation Services). Coverage: Agence de l'eau Loire-Bretagne. The portal shows the English title as "Maps of non-collective sanitation (ANC) on the Loire-Bretagne basin" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agence de l'eau Loire-Bretagne. Its keywords include anc, bassin-loire-bretagne, spanc, assainissement-non-collectif. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2016-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
